feature_descriptions.ss02: allow ·I·Tea to join at the Short height
feature_descriptions.ss03: let x-height exiters join ·Tea: full-size when a baseline-join follows, else the half ·Tea
feature_descriptions.ss04: allow ·It to join at baseline after ·Day and before ·Low
feature_descriptions.ss05: allow ·Et·Tea·… double baseline joins again (older, manual-style behavior)
feature_descriptions.ss06: use gapped ·Owe (doesn’t connect at the top)
feature_descriptions.ss07: allow ·Owe·Day to join at the x-height again
feature_descriptions.ss10: suppress all joins for the wrapped letter(s)

machine_approved.method: Shaped with uharfbuzz in both fixture fonts under every config in the unit's set; outlines decomposed with fontTools DecomposingRecordingPen, translated by the cumulative x_advance plus each glyph's x_offset/y_offset, sorted, and compared.

ink_identical.method: Shaped with uharfbuzz in both fixture fonts under every config in the unit's set; outlines decomposed with fontTools DecomposingRecordingPen, translated by the cumulative x_advance plus each glyph's x_offset/y_offset, sorted, and compared.

picture_identical.method: Not ink-identical, but both fixture fonts fill exactly the same pixel-grid cells under every config in the unit's set; only which glyph owns each pixel differs.

junior_equivalent.method: Divergent only under ss10 and placed-ink-identical to the fixture Junior rendering with its letter tracking removed.

classes.why: Fixture class A: hand-written units exercising the multi-config, ZWNJ, ligation, and duplicate-pin branches of the shard contract.
Fixture class B: hand-written units exercising the namer-dot and pair-null branches.
